string.name: wear_design_import
string.comment: Button in the list of watch face designs: opens the file picker to copy new design zips into AAPS/export

resources.string: Import designs from Google Drive or files

string.name: wear_design_import_done
string.comment: %1$d=number of design zips copied into AAPS/export. Example: Designs imported: 6

string.name: wear_design_import_partly
string.comment: %1$d=number of design zips copied, %2$s=file names that were left out. Example: Designs imported: 5. Not imported: notes.txt

resources.string: Choose the AAPS directory first. The designs are copied to its export folder.
